name: courtyard
description: Self-hosted planning and coding with AI models, one workspace per area of your life

scripts.check: biome check --error-on-warnings . && node scripts/theme/check.ts && node scripts/folders/check.ts && node packages/house/check-size.ts scripts/size/allowed.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p e2e && tsc -p scripts/theme && tsc -p scripts/folders && tsc -p scripts/builds && tsc -p scripts/preview
scripts.test: node scripts/builds/run.ts "pnpm -r test && node --test scripts/theme/check.test.ts scripts/folders/check.test.ts scripts/builds/run.test.ts"
scripts.verify: node scripts/builds/run.ts "pnpm check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm e2e"
